problems: Blind guess (abstract bird/fish or leaf) does not match the intended subject. The figure does read as a tooth once the title is known, but the silhouette is generic: a boxy crown with a triangular root mass and no clearly tooth-like cusp profile.
The gold skeleton follows the blue outline almost exactly, so the figure reads as a traced copy of the silhouette rather than a standalone drawn form.

Stars are mostly on the right parts: top-left cusp (48002), top-right cusp (40680), left corner (50083), right shoulder (39794), left, right and bottom root tips (50954, 37504, 40888), pulp chamber (45238) and root canal (44599) all sit where intended.
Star 44382 ('middle of the top edge') sits on the top edge but is offset from the gold line, and the unlabelled white dot at about (393,147) sits just beside it and looks like a stray.

Label collisions: 'pulp chamber, the living nerve' runs over the blue outline, 'right edge of the pulp chamb' is clipped by the gold line, and 'bottom root tip' overlaps its own star marker and the root line.
Unlabelled stray stars at roughly (273,261), (88,328), (97,363) and (345,453) are not in the key and add clutter, especially near the left root and bottom root.
Orientation is correct: crown up, roots down.
output.advice: Redraw the silhouette so it reads as a tooth on its own: give the crown a clearer cusp profile with two distinct rounded points at top-left (48002) and top-right (40680), and taper the two or three roots downward. Keep the blue silhouette as a loose background shape, not a near-copy of the gold lines. Keep the stars where they are, since they already sit on the right parts. Move star 44382 onto the top edge line, away from the stray dot at about (393,147). Delete the unlabelled stray stars at (273,261), (88,328), (97,363) and (345,453), or label them. Move the labels for the pulp chamber, right edge of the pulp chamber and bottom root tip off the outline and gold lines so none overlap a marker or line.
